Title: Write README
Description:
the readme should include the following information: (1) the kind of files
read/write by the application, e.g., where are the the files stored, etc, ...; (2) which are the controls to use
the application; (3) the formats of the files read/written by the application; (4) the authors of the application;
(5) other information that might be important to use the application.
Author: HE, JIAXU

Title: Add final game completion screen with score summary
Description: This screen should inform the player that the game has been completed and show a summary of the final results.
Author: BENÍTEZ MAIDANA, LUCAS DANIEL

Title: Add confirmation dialog before overwriting a saved game
Description:
When the player tries to save the current game in a slot that already contains a saved game, the application should show a confirmation message before overwriting it.
The player should be able to confirm the overwrite or cancel the action. If the player cancels, the existing saved game must remain unchanged.
Author: BENÍTEZ MAIDANA, LUCAS DANIEL

Title: Add confirmation before restarting a level
Description: When the player chooses to restart a level, the game should ask for confirmation to avoid losing progress accidentally.
Author: BENÍTEZ MAIDANA, LUCAS DANIEL
